求你了！在他讓我心臟病發作之前！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
It's time Mina's children are up and about, Adventurer.
Do you want to play with them and tuck them back into bed while everyone else waits for you to finish?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
冒險者，米娜的孩子們該起床活動了。
你想不想陪他們玩，並在其他人等你時把他們哄回床上？

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
... Soon, my security devices and traps will come out of their low power mode and become mobile again.
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
... 很快，我的安保裝置和陷阱就會退出低功耗模式，重新變得活躍。

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Do you want to lock down Cor, exhaust them, and collect data again?
Please say yes. Let me follow you. I can't wait to get away from this guy.
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
你想封鎖柯爾，耗盡它們的電量，並再次收集資料嗎？
請答應我。讓我跟你去。我迫不及待想離開這傢伙了。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Mm, I'm sorry to hear that. Adventurer, if you'd like to join the operation, then as the leader of the party, please select Ready.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
嗯，很遺憾聽到這個訊息。冒險者，如果您想參加行動，請作為隊伍首領選擇“準備”。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
And after the Memorial dungeon is created and all your party members select Enter, you can select Enter to start the operation.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
記憶地下城建立完成後，當所有隊伍成員都選擇“進入”時，您可以選擇“進入”開始行動。

scripts.text: ^ff0000Please note that you can't clear this dungeon if you try to tame monsters or perform any other irrelevant monster-related activities.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000請注意，如果你試圖馴服魔物或進行其他與魔物相關的無關活動，將無法通關此副本。^000000

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Mm? Mina doesn't think you can do this alone. Please come back in a party, Adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
嗯？米娜認為您無法獨自完成。請組隊後再來，冒險者。

scripts.text: Enter
scripts.translation: 進入

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
There seems to be a problem. Your request has failed. Please try again later. If the problem persists, please contact the Operation Team.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
似乎出現了問題。您的請求已失敗。請稍後再試。如果問題持續存在，請聯絡運營團隊。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Alright, if MD is activated, talk to me again and select ^0000CDEnter^000000. Our operation will begin as soon as you enter.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
好的，如果MD已啟用，請再次與我交談並選擇 ^0000CDEnter^000000。一旦您進入，我們的行動就會開始。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
The dungeon is not yet created. Let me check again.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
地下城尚未建立。讓我再檢查一下。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Your party leader hasn't created the dungeon. Let me check again.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
您的隊伍首領尚未建立地下城。讓我再檢查一下。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
An unknown error has occurred. Let's check it again.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
發生了未知錯誤。讓我們再檢查一下。

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
What are you doing? Come on, let's go. Please? I don't want to stay even a moment longer with that jerk who keeps calling me by that terrible nickname.
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
你在幹什麼？快走吧。求你了！我不想再和那個一直用那個討厭的綽號叫我的混蛋多待一刻。

scripts.text:
[Juslan]
Hm? I think we need to clean up the Heart Hunters in the area.
Aren't you participating in the next operation?
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
嗯？我覺得我們需要清理一下該區域的心之獵手。
你不參加下一次行動嗎？

scripts.text:
[Juslan]
Woah, you worked hard today.
Special forces are on the lookout already, but they haven't found a laboratory...
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
哇哦，你今天辛苦了。
特種部隊已經在搜尋了，但他們還沒找到實驗室...

scripts.text:
[Juslan]
How do the Heart Hunters come back so fast?
I think we should fight again soon, but for now let's take a break.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
心之獵手怎麼恢復得這麼快？
我覺得我們應該很快再打一次，但現在先休息一下。

scripts.text:
[Juslan]
Huh~ Did you rest well?
Let's prepare for a Heart Hunter hunt.
When you're ready, let's go again.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
呼~ 你休息得好嗎？
讓我們準備去獵殺心之獵手吧。
當你準備好了，我們就再次出發。

scripts.text:
[Juslan]
Please handle 15 ^0000FFHeart Hunter Bellares and  Heart Hunter Sanares.^000000
I want to get battle information.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
請處理15個 ^0000FF心之獵手貝拉蕾 和 心之獵手薩納蕾^000000。
我想獲取戰鬥資訊。

scripts.text:
[Juslan]
You know the location, right?
You can follow the track from there.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
你知道地點，對吧？
你可以從那裡追蹤蹤跡。

scripts.text:
[Juslan]
These guys were stronger than expected.
It seems like their equipment or abilities have increased in various ways.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
這些傢伙比預期的更強。
看來他們的裝備或能力在各個方面都有提升。

scripts.text:
[Juslan]
I wonder if those were strengthened through the experimentation in this lab?
They've become so strong now, I don't trust these people...
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
我想知道它們是否是通過這個實驗室的實驗被強化的？
它們現在變得這麼強，我不信任這些人...

scripts.text:
[Juslan]
Thank you very much for today's work.
Take a rest for now.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
非常感謝你今天的工作。
現在先休息一下。

scripts.text:
[Juslan]
The Heart Hunters Bellares and the Sanares are not like those we've met before.
They are hard to deal with.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
心之獵手貝拉蕾和薩納蕾不像我們以前遇到的那樣。
它們很難對付。

scripts.text:
[Juslan]
Because of that, the Est special troops are hiding in the battlefield to advance further.
We have to deal with those guys, sometimes it's hard.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
因此，埃斯特的特種部隊正隱藏在戰場上以進一步行動。
我們必須處理這些傢伙，有時候這很難。

scripts.text: Let's do it.
scripts.translation: 就這麼辦。

scripts.text: That sounds like trouble.
scripts.translation: 聽起來很麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Juslan]
It will  be. Huh.
The adventurer should take a break.
Your body must be tired.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
確實如此。嗯。
冒險者應該休息一下。
你的身體一定很疲憊了。

scripts.text:
[Juslan]
That's good to hear.
Will you able to deal with Heart Hunter Bellares and Sanares properly?
Please hunt down 15 of each Heart Hunters.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
聽到你這麼說很好。
你能妥善應對心之獵手貝拉蕾和薩納蕾嗎？
請各獵殺15只心之獵手。

scripts.text:
[Juslan]
I want to gather more combat data if possible.
I would really appreciate it.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
如果可能的話，我想收集更多戰鬥資料。
那就拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Farmhand]
Sorry, I'm busy. I don't think you city people want to be here because it smells like fertilizer. Why don't you go over there and join the others where the researchers used to be?
scripts.translation:
[農場幫工]
抱歉，我很忙。我覺得你們城裡人不會想待在這裡，因為這裡聞起來像肥料。你們為什麼不去那邊，加入以前研究員所在的地方呢？

scripts.text:
[Farmhand]
We're here to grow vegetables. This self-sufficient farm is our pride and joy.
scripts.translation:
[農場幫工]
我們在這裡種菜。這個自給自足的農場是我們的驕傲和快樂。

scripts.text:
[Farmhand]
But since this incident, many members in our staff have requested a transfer, leaving us short-staffed. Would you be so kind as to help us tend to our crops?
scripts.translation:
[農場幫工]
但自從這次事件以來，我們員工中的許多成員都要求調離，導致人手不足。你能否好心幫我們照料一下莊稼？

scripts.text: Help.
scripts.translation: 幫忙

scripts.text: Do not help.
scripts.translation: 不幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Farmhand]
You big shots came here and ruined our peace.
scripts.translation:
[農場幫工]
你們這些大人物來這裡，破壞了我們這裡的安寧。

scripts.text:
[Farmhand]
Ban, forget it. What we had prob'bly wasn't real peace, anyway.
scripts.translation:
[農場幫工]
算了，別提了。我們之前擁有的可能本來就不是真正的安寧。

scripts.text:
[Farmhand]
Thank you! We grow grapes, green beans, and pumpkins in our farm, and they each have different needs.
scripts.translation:
[農場幫工]
謝謝！我們在農場裡種葡萄、青豆和南瓜，它們各自有不同的需求。

scripts.text:
[Farmhand]
For the grapes, please {0}. For the green beans, {1}. And for the pumpkins, {2}.
Then, I'll be countin' on you.
scripts.translation:
[農場幫工]
對於葡萄，請{0}。對於青豆，{1}。對於南瓜，{2}。
那就拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Alert]
 - Your bag is full. Please check your weight and carrying item quantity, and then talk to me again. -
scripts.translation:
[警報]
 - 你的背包已滿。請檢查你的負重和攜帶物品數量，然後再次與我交談。 -

scripts.text:
[Farmhand]
You took care of them all. For an adventurer, you're pretty good at tendin' to gardens.
scripts.translation:
[農場幫工]
你都照顧好了。作為一個冒險者，你挺擅長照料花園的。

scripts.text:
[Farmhand]
We don't have anythin' to give you, but maybe you could have these components that we've found around here. I saw the mercenaries collectin' them. Don't you need them, too?
scripts.translation:
[農場幫工]
我們沒什麼可以給你的，但也許你可以拿這些我們在附近發現的部件。我看到僱傭兵們在收集它們。你不需要嗎？

scripts.text:
[Farmhand]
Our crops need to be tended every day. Please come back and help us again.
scripts.translation:
[農場幫工]
我們的莊稼需要每天照料。請回來再幫我們一次。

scripts.text:
[Farmhand]
Ah, you're not done yet.
scripts.translation:
[農場幫工]
啊，你還沒做完呢。

scripts.text:
[Farmhand]
For the grapes, you have to {0}. For the green beans, {1}. And for the pumpkins, {2}.
scripts.translation:
[農場幫工]
對於葡萄，你必須{0}。對於青豆，{1}。對於南瓜，{2}。

scripts.text:
[Farmhand]
Please make sure you do all these.
scripts.translation:
[農場幫工]
請確保你完成了所有這些。

scripts.text:
[Farmhand]
Our crops are good for now. Messin' with them too often ain't good for them. They may not look it, but they're pretty sensitive.
scripts.translation:
[農場幫工]
我們的莊稼現在狀態良好。太頻繁地折騰它們對它們不好。它們看起來可能不敏感，但實際上很敏感。

scripts.text:
[Farmhand]
Please come back after dawn. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[農場幫工]
請在黎明後回來。謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Farmhand]
Enough time has passed for our crops to need tendin' again. Would you help us again?
scripts.translation:
[農場幫工]
時間過得真快，我們的莊稼又需要照料了。你願意再幫幫我們嗎？

scripts.text:
[Farmhand]
Since you came along, I've been havin' more things to do, and there's only so much one man can do.
scripts.translation:
[農場幫工]
自從你來了之後，我要做的事情變多了，但一個人的精力畢竟有限。

scripts.text: Help.
scripts.translation: 幫忙

scripts.text: Do not help.
scripts.translation: 不幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Farmhand]
Ah, I understand. Thanks to you guys, I've got more things to do with fewer men to do them with, but I'm alright.
scripts.translation:
[農場幫工]
啊，我懂了。多虧了你們，雖然人手少了，但要做的事卻變多了，不過我還應付得來。

scripts.text:
[Farmhand]
Well, forget it. You're prob'bly too busy yourself. But what do I know? I'm just a farmhand.
scripts.translation:
[農場幫工]
算了，你大概也很忙吧。不過我也知道，我只是一個普通的農場幫工。

scripts.text:
[Farmhand]
Thank you. We've got grapes, green beans, and pumpkins, and I believe I've told you they each have different needs.
scripts.translation:
[農場幫工]
謝謝。我們有葡萄、青豆和南瓜，我想我已經告訴過你，它們各自有不同的需求。

scripts.text:
[Farmhand]
For the grapes, please {0}. For the green beans, {1}. And for the pumpkins, {2}. Since you know the drill, I won't say more.
scripts.translation:
[農場幫工]
對於葡萄，請{0}。對於青豆，{1}。對於南瓜，{2}。既然你已經知道流程了，我就不多說了。

scripts.text:
[Farmhand]
Sorry, I'm busy. I don't think you city people want to be here because it smells like fertilizer. Why don't you go over there and join the others where the researchers used to be?
scripts.translation:
[農場幫工]
抱歉，我很忙。我覺得你們城裡人不會想待在這裡，因為這裡聞起來像肥料。你們為什麼不去那邊，加入以前研究員所在的地方呢？

scripts.text:
[Green Beans]
Small green beans are hanging from the healthy-looking beanstalks.
scripts.translation:
[青豆]
健康的豆藤上掛著小小的青豆。

scripts.text:
[Green Beans]
Small green beans are hanging from the rejuvenated beanstalks.
scripts.translation:
[青豆]
恢復生機的豆藤上掛著小小的青豆。

scripts.text:
[Green Beans]
These green beans look a little bit lifeless.
scripts.translation:
[青豆]
這些青豆看起來有點無精打采。

scripts.text: Catch aphids.
scripts.translation: 捕捉蚜蟲

scripts.text: Spread fertilizer.
scripts.translation: 施肥

scripts.text: Pull weeds.
scripts.translation: 拔除雜草

scripts.text:
[Green Beans]
I caught aphids on the green bean stalks.
scripts.translation:
[青豆]
我捕捉了青豆豆藤上的蚜蟲。

scripts.text:
[Green Beans]
I spread fertilizer around the green beans.
scripts.translation:
[青豆]
我在青豆周圍施了肥。

scripts.text:
[Green Beans]
I pulled weeds around the green beans.
scripts.translation:
[青豆]
我拔除了青豆周圍的雜草。

scripts.text:
[Green Beans]
Why do they still look wilted?
scripts.translation:
[青豆]
為什麼它們看起來還是枯萎的樣子？

scripts.text:
[Green Beans]
Oooh, I can tell the green beans are happy now!
scripts.translation:
[青豆]
噢，我能感覺到青豆現在很開心！

scripts.text:
[Green Beans]
I've tended to all the crops. I should go back to the Farmhand.
scripts.translation:
[青豆]
我已經照料完所有的莊稼了。我該回去找農場幫工了。

scripts.text:
[Pumpkins]
Small, fussy leaves have grown out of the healthy-looking pumpkin vines.
scripts.translation:
[南瓜]
健康的南瓜藤上長出了細小、嬌嫩的葉子。

scripts.text:
[Pumpkins]
Small, fussy leaves have grown out of the rejuvenated pumpkin vines.
scripts.translation:
[南瓜]
恢復生機的南瓜藤上長出了細小、嬌嫩的葉子。

scripts.text:
[Pumpkins]
These pumpkin vines look a little bit lifeless.
scripts.translation:
[南瓜]
這些南瓜藤看起來有點沒精神。

scripts.text: Catch aphids.
scripts.translation: 捕捉蚜蟲

scripts.text: Spread fertilizer.
scripts.translation: 施肥

scripts.text: Pull weeds.
scripts.translation: 拔除雜草

scripts.text:
[Pumpkins]
I caught aphids on the pumpkin vines.
scripts.translation:
[南瓜]
我在南瓜藤上捉到了蚜蟲。

scripts.text:
[Pumpkins]
I spread fertilizer on the pumpkin vines.
scripts.translation:
[南瓜]
我在南瓜藤上施了肥。

scripts.text:
[Pumpkins]
I pulled weeds around the pumpkin vines.
scripts.translation:
[南瓜]
我拔掉了南瓜藤周圍的雜草。

scripts.text:
[Pumpkins]
Why do they still look wilted?
scripts.translation:
[南瓜]
為什麼它們看起來還是枯萎的樣子？

scripts.text:
[Pumpkins]
Oooh, I can tell the pumpkins are happy now!
scripts.translation:
[南瓜]
噢，我能感覺到南瓜現在很開心！

scripts.text:
[Pumpkins]
I've tended to all the crops. I should go back to the Farmhand.
scripts.translation:
[南瓜]
我已經照料完所有的莊稼了。我該回去找農場幫工了。

scripts.text:
[Grapes]
Clusters of small green grapes are hanging from the healthy-looking grapevines.
scripts.translation:
[葡萄]
健康的葡萄藤上掛著一串串小小的青葡萄。

scripts.text:
[Grapes]
Clusters of small green grapes are hanging from the rejuvenated grapevines.
scripts.translation:
[葡萄]
恢復生機的葡萄藤上掛著一串串小小的青葡萄。

scripts.text:
[Grapes]
These grapes look a little bit lifeless.
scripts.translation:
[葡萄]
這些葡萄看起來有點沒精神。

scripts.text: Catch aphids.
scripts.translation: 捕捉蚜蟲

scripts.text: Spread fertilizer.
scripts.translation: 施肥

scripts.text: Pull weeds.
scripts.translation: 拔除雜草

scripts.text:
[Grapes]
I caught aphids on the grapevines.
scripts.translation:
[葡萄]
我在葡萄藤上捉到了蚜蟲。

scripts.text:
[Grapes]
I spread fertilizer around the grapes.
scripts.translation:
[葡萄]
我在葡萄周圍施了肥。

scripts.text:
[Grapes]
I pulled weeds around the grapes.
scripts.translation:
[葡萄]
我拔掉了葡萄周圍的雜草。

scripts.text:
[Grapes]
Why do they still look wilted?
scripts.translation:
[葡萄]
為什麼它們看起來還是枯萎的樣子？

scripts.text:
[Grapes]
Oooh, I can tell the grapes are happy now!
scripts.translation:
[葡萄]
噢，我能感覺到葡萄現在很開心！

scripts.text:
[Grapes]
I've tended to all the crops. I should go back to the Farmhand.
scripts.translation:
[葡萄]
我已經照料完所有的莊稼了。我該回去找農場幫工了。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Do you need help? If you have business with the <NAVI>[Rebellion]<INFO>sp_cor,127,140,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>, then head southwest.
In the southeast, there's the <NAVI>[plantation]<INFO>sp_cor,243,84,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> that we believe to exist for food supply and research purposes.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
你需要幫助嗎？如果你要找<NAVI>[反叛者]<INFO>sp_cor,127,140,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，請往西南方向走。
東南方有一處<NAVI>[種植園]<INFO>sp_cor,243,84,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，我們推測它是為了食物供應和研究目的而存在的。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
The <NAVI>[tents]<INFO>sp_cor,159,220,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> in the northwest are dangerous. Please stay away from them. The same goes for the <NAVI>[waterway]<INFO>sp_cor,236,275,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> in the northeast.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
西北方的<NAVI>[帳篷]<INFO>sp_cor,159,220,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>很危險。請遠離它們。東北方的<NAVI>[水道]<INFO>sp_cor,236,275,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>也是如此。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
(I'm too busy glaring right now!)
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
（我現在正忙著瞪人呢！）

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Finally, it's time for Lucky Rookie to shine. Ooh, can't wait!
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
終於到了拉基新人大放異彩的時候了。噢，迫不及待了！

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
...
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
...

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Stop talking to me!
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
別跟我說話！

scripts.text:
[Tes]
Since this is an important interrogation, there should be as many government agents present as the others, to prevent miscommunication later.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
既然這是一次重要的審訊，就應該像其他人一樣，安排儘可能多的政府特工在場，以防之後出現溝通誤會。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
I wonder how valuable these things are. How much do they cost? I want to touch and smell them. They smell and feel like valuables, I bet!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
我猜這些東西肯定很值錢。它們值多少錢？我想摸摸它們，聞聞它們。它們聞起來摸起來都很貴重，我敢打賭！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
They're probably only valuable to scientists and researchers. You'd better not touch them. You could lose your hands.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
它們大概只對科學家和研究員有價值。你最好別碰它們，不然你的手可能會廢掉。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I decided to go along with the adventurer's suggestion and conduct a new investigation. But I wonder if I made the right choice.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我決定採納冒險者的建議，進行一次新的調查。但我不知道自己做的是否是正確的選擇。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Daisy, I don't like his eyes and his manner of speech. Are all government people like this?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
黛西，我不喜歡他的眼神和說話方式。政府的人都是這樣的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Aas]
I don't know what the Vice President is thinking... But I'm going with him, even if I don't have to.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
我不知道副總統在想什麼... 但即使我不願意，我也會跟著他。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
I can't stand now, I was soaked in blood earlier. I would have followed them but I couldn't stand.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
我現在站不起來了，剛才渾身是血。我本想跟著他們，但我站不起來。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Hey, what the hell is this commotion all about?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
嘿，這到底是怎麼回事？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
For whom and for what have I been working for... they have so much resources...
scripts.translation:
[工人]
我到底在為誰、為了什麼而工作... 他們擁有那麼多資源...

scripts.text:
[Sentinel]
You can rest assured, there are eyes everywhere here. I'm being careful.
scripts.translation:
[哨兵]
你可以放心，這裡到處都是眼線。我正在小心應對。

scripts.text:
[Sentinel]
It's safe here. Even if it's a big place, they won't attack randomly.
scripts.translation:
[哨兵]
這裡很安全。即使地方很大，他們也不會隨意發動攻擊。

scripts.text:
[Sentinel]
If we're going to have a raid next time, we'll have to be thorough.
scripts.translation:
[哨兵]
如果下次我們要進行突襲，就必須徹底一點。

scripts.text:
[Sentinel]
There's nothing that stands out in this location!
scripts.translation:
[哨兵]
這個地方沒有什麼特別顯眼的東西！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Scientists, researchers, everyone here just pretends things are fine.
Arthur, don't touch these or your hands will melt.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
科學家、研究員，這裡的人都在假裝一切正常。
亞瑟，別碰這些，不然你的手會融化的。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Are these expensive? I want to see them closer! I want to smell it!
The feeling of something valuable!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
這些很貴嗎？我想湊近看看！我想聞聞！
那種貴重物品的感覺！

scripts.text:
[Worker]
I can't go now, but when I'm old enough, I'll go and work. I don't have time to play.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
我現在去不了，但等我長大了，我會去工作的。我沒有時間玩耍。

scripts.text:
[Wilde]
What? Is this your first time here?
The drinks come from over there.
scripts.translation:
[王爾德]
什麼？你是第一次來這裡嗎？
飲料在那邊。

scripts.text:
[Wilde]
This place is for adults only.
scripts.translation:
[王爾德]
這裡僅限成年人進入。

scripts.text:
[Wilde]
Hey! What's going on here?
scripts.translation:
[王爾德]
嘿！這裡發生什麼事了？

scripts.text:
[Wilde]
What? Are you the guy they're waiting for? You see the room behind me? Go ahead and go in.
scripts.translation:
[王爾德]
什麼？你就是他們等的那個人嗎？
看到我身後的房間了嗎？請進吧。

scripts.text:
[Wilde]
Are you going in? It's pretty loud so I'll go in later.
scripts.translation:
[王爾德]
你要進去嗎？裡面挺吵的，我稍後再進去。

scripts.text:
[Wilde]
Wait nobody is back there now, are you waiting for someone?
scripts.translation:
[王爾德]
等等，現在後面沒人，你在等誰嗎？

scripts.text:
[Retired Rebellion]
Are you going to the backroom?
scripts.translation:
[退隱的反叛者]
你要去後面的房間嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: Not yet.
scripts.translation: 還沒有準備好。

scripts.text:
[Retired Rebellion]
Take your time.
scripts.translation:
[退隱的反叛者]
請慢走。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
I'm sorry, but you're not allowed to go inside.
It's dangerous at the moment because the mine is closed.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成員]
很抱歉，您不能進入內部。
目前礦場已關閉，十分危險。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
Hello adventurer!
This way, I'll let you in the mines.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成員]
你好，冒險者！
請跟我來，我帶你進入礦場。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Aaaah... I haven't finished yet.
It's more secure than I thought.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
啊...我還沒弄完。
比我想的要牢固多了。

scripts.text: Jump over the barrier.
scripts.translation: 跳過屏障

scripts.text: Go back.
scripts.translation: 回去

scripts.text: Jump the barrier.
scripts.translation: 翻越屏障

scripts.text: Go back.
scripts.translation: 回去

scripts.text: - You're not allowed to enter this area. -
scripts.translation: - 禁止進入該區域。-

scripts.text: - You can't enter yet. -
scripts.translation: - 暫時無法進入。-
